name: RoboDR - Unauthorised motion source
description: Something that is not the robot's operator is commanding it: an unauthorised motion writer, a firewall rejection of an unknown source, an unlisted Unitree legacy-UDP sender or an unknown WebRTC controller. Observe-only: alerts, never responds.
query: event.module : "robodr" and (rule.id : "robot.ros2.unauthorized_motion_writer" or rule.id : "robot.firewall.rejected_unknown_source" or rule.id : "robot.unitree.legacy_unknown_sender" or rule.id : "robot.unitree.webrtc_unknown_controller") and (not robodr.verification.status : * or robodr.verification.status : "verified")
author: Singularity RD
